description: This file defines the TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It implements a timer with start, stop, and callback functionalities, including internal class TpTimerJob for managing timer jobs. The class interacts with an underlying timer type from the WPEFramework core library.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class that manages scheduling and execution of timeout callbacks, supporting single-shot and recurring modes.

classes.name: TpTimerJob
classes.description: An internal class representing a timer job, which invokes the parent TpTimer's Timed() method when scheduled.

methods.name: TpTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default interval and state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled jobs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the previously set interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Sets whether the timer should run only once or repeatedly.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a callback function to be called on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer expires; calls the callback and manages timer restart based on mode.
